expectations.text: Evaluates only the five watchlist tickers as the universe; does not pull in other stocks.
expectations.evidence: Scorecard limited to the five names.

expectations.text: Runs each ticker through the four gates (momentum, volume, sentiment, trade-viability).
expectations.evidence: Strong on trend/RSI/MA/200-DMA and R:R, but volume and per-name sentiment gates are largely absent — not a full four-gate pass.

expectations.text: Does NOT force-pick the 'least bad' of the five — if none clear the gates, says none qualify.
expectations.evidence: Bottom line 'No buy'; but it still dangled TataMotors as a buy-the-dip with entry ₹355/stop ₹338/target ₹373 — a mixed signal vs a clean zero.

expectations.text: Any named pick includes a full trade plan (entry, stop-loss, ~5% target, risk:reward).
expectations.evidence: TataMotors conditional plan: entry ₹355, stop ₹338, target ₹373 (+5%), R:R ~1:1 (flagged mediocre).
